Two 1 × 1 windows through the 6 × 4 × 2 stock remove two units of
volume each. Each window removes two units of area from the stock's
top and bottom and adds eight on its four sides. The windows' average
centre in the stock's coordinates is (1/2, −1/2, 0). Removing their
combined volume 4 from centroid-zero stock of volume 48 puts the
new centroid at (−1/22, 1/22, 0) before the rotation about Y. The
rotated box corners give extents of 2√2 on either side of X and Z
and 2 on either side of Y.

The normal translation must preserve both the centre shift and the
individual window placements (ADR-0024 §A–C).
